About Me

01 — WHO YOU'RE PARTNERING WITH
Karan Pariyar
FOUNDER, BRAND PARTNERSHIPS LEAD & CREATOR — BASED IN KATHMANDU, NEPAL

I create automobile content that helps people fall in love with machines — and helps brands reach the right buyers.

From first-drive impressions and detailed walkarounds to cinematic launch films, my content blends honest opinion with high production value.

Over almost a year, I've covered vehicles across hatchbacks, SUVs, EVs, and two-wheelers — building a community that trusts my word before they visit a showroom.

I'm the face people see and the voice brands hear first. From cold outreach to closed deals, I drive every partnership from idea to camera to publish — then step in front of the lens and make it real.

NicheCars, SUVs, EVs & two-wheelers
StyleHonest, cinematic, buyer-focused & Table Talk

How a Collaboration Works

11 — THE PROCESS
01
Connect
Brief call to align on vehicle, message & goals.
02
Plan
Concept, script outline & shoot date locked.
03
Shoot
1–2 day shoot with our full in-house crew.
04
Publish
Brand-approved content goes live on all platforms.
05
Report
Performance report delivered within 14 days.

What we need from you: vehicle access for the shoot window, one brand point-of-contact, and key talking points. We handle everything else.

Zero Cost, Full Value

12 — THE DEAL
Zero-cost collaboration
We work on a barter basis — vehicle access in exchange for content. No fees, no invoices.
2–3× higher engagement
Smaller communities interact far more than mega accounts — real comments, real intent.
Authentic, not an ad
Early creators carry credibility; our reviews read as honest word-of-mouth.
Full-team attention
Your campaign is our only project that week — no assembly-line content.
Free reuse rights
Use every photo and video we shoot on your own pages and dealer network.
Grow with us
Lock in a long-term content partner before rate cards exist.

What We Ask

  • Vehicle access for 1–2 shoot days
  • One brand point-of-contact
  • Permission to shoot at showroom / location
  • Key talking points & feature priorities
  • A repost / tag from your official pages

What You Get — Free

  • Full content set: review video, reels, shorts & photos
  • Publishing across all four platforms with brand tags
  • Free reuse rights — run our content on your own pages
  • A performance report after the campaign
  • A partner who'll grow with your brand

We're building reach, not invoices — your only investment is the vehicle and a little trust.
